topics.title: Nerandomilast SSc适应症中国开发策略（研究1305-0052）

background.text: 全球策略：基于FIBRONEER-ILD试验SSc-ILD亚组数据及支持性临床前证据，不等待ph2b CONQUEST试验结果，直接推进SSc适应症ph3试验。
background.quote: The global strategy involves proceeding directly to a ph3 trial for the SSc indication without awaiting results from the ph2b CONQUEST trial, based on encouraging subgroup data for SSc-ILD from the FIBRONEER-ILD trial and supportive preclinical evidence.

background.text: 中国整合策略已于2025年8月获CEC背书。
background.quote: China integration strategy for SSc project has been endorsed by CEC in Aug 2025.

background.text: FDA、CDE和PMDA的Pre-CTA HAI反馈一致指出现有数据不足以支持SSc确证性ph3试验，并提出最终NDA批准风险。
background.quote: Feedback from FDA, CDE and PMDA consistently highlighted that the current data is insufficient for a confirmatory ph3 trial in SSc. Risks for the final NDA approval of SSc indication were also raised.

background.text: BUEC于2025年11月18日发布SSc的RoFD，SSc ph3试验将按计划推进。
background.quote: RoFD for SSc was released by BUEC on Nov 18th and ph3 trial in SSc will be proceed.

background.text: 中国CTA潜在风险：CDE尚未就具体研究设计提供反馈，CTA审评期间可能附带证据不足相关备注；EC可能因SSc患者风险获益不明确提出顾虑；NDA批准SSc适应症存在挑战。
background.quote:
CTA: CDE has not yet provided feedback regarding the specific study design and further review will be needed during CTA review; although the likelihood of CDE directly rejecting the CTA application is low, the approval letter may include remarks related to insufficient evidence and concerns.
    - EC: Concerns may be raised by site ECs due to unclear risk-benefit profile in SSc patients, which could potentially impact the subsequent trial execution.
    - NDA: remarks on the HAI feedback and CTA approval letter need to be addressed in NDA submission; approval of SSc indication may be challengi

background.text: 中国CTA提交策略（FDA反馈后提交）已于11月获CEC背书，并与全球ET对齐；NDA批准风险已于11月告知本地AT。
background.quote:
China CTA submission strategy has been endorsed by CEC in Nov and aligned with global ET.
Risks associated with final NDA approval were communicated to local AT in Nov.

background.text: FDA反馈：SSc-ILD亚组数据对更广泛SSc人群的相关性不确定，建议开展ph2剂量探索/POC试验；基于现有数据推进ph3由申办方自行决定。
background.quote: FDA: The SSc-ILD subgroup data’s relevance to the broader SSc population remains uncertain; a ph 2 dose-finding/POC trial is recommended to guide ph3; conducting a ph3 trial based on available data is at your discretion.

background.text: CDE反馈：现有证据不足以直接推进SSc确证性试验，需开展剂量探索试验或提供额外证据。
background.quote: CDE: current evidence is insufficient to justify proceeding directly to a pivotal trial for SSc; a dose-exploratory trial for SSc or provide additional evidence would support advancing to a pivotal trial for SSc.

background.text: PMDA反馈：因证据不足，该试验不能被视为确证性研究；即使主要终点达到，也存在被否定判断的高风险；即使基于试验结果开展NDA前咨询，也担忧无法获得NDA批准。
background.quote: PMDA: Interpreting the results may be difficult, and there is a high risk that a negative judgment may have to be made even if proposed primary endpoint meets; no intention to halt the conduct of the 1305-0052 trial due to no safety concerns; even if a pre-NDA consultation is conducted based on the trial’s findings, there is concern that it may not result in NDA approval.

background.text: 1305-0052试验设计：N≈448，1:1随机，Nerandomilast 18mg bid vs 安慰剂，主要终点为至疾病进展或全因死亡时间，关键次要终点为第52周FVC变化和mRSS变化。
background.quote:
Primary Endpoint:
Time to the first occurrence of disease progression or all-cause death:
Adjudicated SSc-related clinically meaningful disease progression or complications*, or
Absolute decline in FVC% predicted ≥5%, or
Relative increase in mRSS ≥25% and absolute increase in mRSS ≥5 points, or
All-cause death

background.text: 1305-0052主要终点（至疾病进展或死亡时间）在其他SSc关键试验中尚无先例作为主要终点使用。
background.quote: The primary endpoint proposed in the 1305-0052 trial has not been used as the primary endpoint in other pivotal trials for SSc.

decision.text: 本次PEC讨论性质为信息共享和征求建议，非背书请求。
decision.quote: ✔ For Sharing  ✔  For Advice   □ For Endorsement

todo.text: 准备HAI回复并纳入CTA提交包（owner/due/status：原文未说明）。
todo.quote: HAI response will be prepared and incorporated into the CTA submission packages.

todo.text: 与全球ET保持密切沟通，就CTA补充支持性证据进行协调（owner/due/status：原文未说明）。
todo.quote: Maintain close communication with global ET regarding the supplemental supporting evidence for the CTA.

todo.text: 与全球ET和本地AT保持密切沟通，就未来NDA策略进行协调（owner/due/status：原文未说明）。
todo.quote: Maintain close communication with global ET and local AT about the future NDA strategy.
